title: Silver Peacock for Best Debut Feature Film of a Director awarded to Bérenger Thouin for ‘The Golden Age’ at 57th IFFI
subtitle: Jury applauds the director’s skilful blending of archival material with real footage in an ambitious period film
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 7:57PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343204 Views: 125 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Urdu हिन्दी Marathi Gujarati Malayalam
Goa, 28 November 2026 Bérenger Thouin has been awarded the Silver Peacock for Best Debut Feature Film of a Director for his film ‘The Golden Age’ at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). The award was presented by Chief Minister of Goa, Dr. Pramod Sawant, in the presence of Shri Chanchal Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, and Festival Director Shri Ashutosh Gowariker. Céleste Thouin, brother of Bérenger Thouin and the music composer of the film, received the award on behalf of the director at the closing ceremony of the festival. Recognising the ambition and cinematic craftsmanship of the debutant director, the jury commended Thouin for successfully navigating the challenges of creating a period film spanning several years. The jury particularly appreciated his innovative approach to integrating archival material with real footage. “ It is unusual for a first film to deal with all the challenges of a period piece that spans over years, but this one managed to tackle and overcome every difficulty in its way by a clever way of mixing the archives with the real footage ,” the jury observed. With this recognition, Bérenger Thouin’s debut feature stands out for its ambitious storytelling and inventive use of the cinematic medium. The Best Debut Feature Film of a Director competition seeks to encourage new directorial talent in world cinema. This year, the competition featured seven films, comprising five international and two Indian films. The award, conferred on the director, comprises the Silver Peacock trophy, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹15 lakh. Synopsis of ‘The Golden Age’ Born into a butcher’s family at the dawn of the twentieth century, Jeanne Lavaur dreams of becoming a countess. Inspired by the fearless Céleste and driven by her love for Guillaume de Barante, Jeanne embarks on a journey through the vibrant Paris of the 1920s and the turbulent years of two World Wars. Against the backdrop of a century marked by profound transformations, she emerges as an independent woman determined to shape her own destiny. Silver Peacock Honour for The Golden Age 👏🎬
